notes.title: New update for MAGIX Video deluxe 2021 Plus Steam Edition!
notes.content:
Important changes in version 20.0.1.80 compared to version 20.0.1.65

Fixed: Erroneous files arrangement in the scene overview after "Drag & Drop".
Fixed: Distortions in vertical videos if "performance optimization" is activated.
Fixed: Thumbnail aspect ratio in the project list
Fixed: Software crash if "Collage" is selected while closing a project
Fixed: Software crash when opening old projects with corrupted Transition settings
Fixed: Software crash when importing videos with multiple audio tracks
Improved: Framerate detection for MXF files.
Improved: Input of negative values for "OpenFX-effects" is now possible.
Improved: Support for iPhone 12 photos and videos files (HEIF/HEVC)
Removed: "Extended audio package" - Removes AC-3 import/export on Windows 7 and 5.1 Surround export on Windows 8/10
Removed: Import/export files via "MAGIX Intermediate codec".
